articles.title: Dinari brings tokenized U.S. stocks to American investors as equity race heats up
articles.snippet: The move brings the custodial tokenization model to eligible U.S. investors as competition over blockchain-based equities intensifies.

articles.title: BNY to add crypto staking to digital asset custody platform
articles.snippet: The custody bank has selected Galaxy to provide staking infrastructure as it broadens services for institutional crypto investors.

articles.title: Crypto firms still seeking frontier AI access; only select few have it
articles.snippet: Crypto executives say restricting powerful AI models may initially be justified, but it doesn’t make sense as open-source alternatives become more capable.

articles.title: FalconX cuts 10% of workforce amid prolonged crypto market slump: Report
articles.snippet: According to Bloomberg, the digital asset prime broker is refocusing its Singapore strategy and withdrawing its local license application as crypto companies continue to trim costs.

articles.title: BlackRock Tokenizes $311B of European Money Market Funds With JP Morgan's Kinexys
articles.snippet: Europe's largest cash management platform is now issuing tokens on Ethereum, in a launch restricted to professional investors.
